subject: [PATCH 33/60] cgroup/cpuset: ignore private nodes when matching OOM victims

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author provided a clear explanation of the problem and proposed solution. They demonstrated an understanding of the OOM killer's behavior and how private nodes can cause issues in certain scenarios.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the cgroup/cpuset subsystem, specifically related to memory management and OOM (Out-Of-Memory) killer behavior. The goal is to ensure that the OOM killer correctly identifies eligible victims based on their memory allocation constraints. This particular patch focuses on ignoring private nodes when matching OOM victims, preventing potential issues where tasks in one cpuset could be killed by an OOM event in another cpuset.
